turn.user_message: Who has to agree to this?
turn.context: Processes place, turn 2 (who agrees, team by team, and the one approver of the flow).

text: Nine teams are touched, but only one approves the flow. Your Head of Operations signs off the new order of work, not the daily tasks.
Doctors matter most. You said they do not use voice notes, so the trial asks them for one tap, not a new habit.
chat.invite: Next, we can walk through each change on the ward.
chat.note: Help with each job first. Fewer hours come later.
prompts: What changes on the ward, step by step?
How do we win over the doctors?
Do we need to hire anyone?
chat.pointer: Pick a name badge to see what changes for that person.

blocks.title: Nine badges, one approver
blocks.deck: Each badge says where that person stands. Most are still to ask.

blocks.rule: Tojo comes in as help with each job, not a threat to it. Any fall in staff hours comes later, once it is trusted.

sheets.title: Head of Operations
sheets.text: Signs off the new order of work across departments. Takes no part in the daily tasks.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: One Discharge Manager reports the numbers every week.

sheets.entry: What would your Head of Operations say?

sheets.title: Doctors
sheets.text: Mark likely discharges on the evening round with one tap. Sign the early summary.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: The summary is ready to check, not to write.

lines.label: What you told us
lines.value: “Our doctors don’t use voice notes.” So the trial uses a tap.

sheets.title: Nurses
sheets.text: Record the ready and leaving times. Start the papers after the evening round.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: No rush for medicines and papers at noon.

sheets.title: Billing
sheets.text: Checks a bill kept up to date all stay, instead of building it at the end.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: No pile of bills at noon.

sheets.title: Insurance desk
sheets.text: Sends the early request the evening before.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: Fewer calls chasing the insurer the next day.

sheets.title: Housekeeping
sheets.text: Hears the moment a patient leaves, with the bed number.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: No waiting for a phone call.

sheets.title: Pharmacy and diet
sheets.text: Told that evening who goes home tomorrow.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: Medicines packed before the morning rush.

sheets.entry: What would pharmacy and diet say?

sheets.title: Bed desk
sheets.text: Sees each bed turn ready without a call.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: The next patient is placed sooner.

sheets.title: IT team
sheets.text: Lets Tojo read the hospital software. Nothing can be changed or deleted.

lines.label: What they gain
lines.value: One clear list, asked for once.

sheets.entry: What would your IT team say?
